# pkflagr

<!-- badges: start -->
<!-- badges: end -->

In clinical studies, concomitant administration of drugs that are precipitants
of pharmacokinetic drug-drug interactions (DDI) may influence the
pharmacokinetics (PK) of the study drug.
This package provides function to identify and flag such concomitant
medications.

## Installation

You can install the development version of pkflagr like so:

``` r
library(devtools)
devtools::install_github("rstrotmann/pkflagr)
```
